hospitals.title: Companies
hospitals.list_description: View tenants created from the master and add new companies.
hospitals.platform_only: Company management is available only on the master host (mek360.com).
hospitals.create_description: Add a new company tenant. The site at `{slug}.mek360.com` is started with defaults immediately.
hospitals.create_form_section_desc: Enter the company identifier and display details.
hospitals.create_success: Company has been added. Open the new site to confirm operational settings.
hospitals.field_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (e.g. freshent → freshent.mek360.com).
hospitals.field_slug_invalid: Slug must contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; must start and end with alphanumerics.
hospitals.field_name_hint: Used as the site display name.
hospitals.logo_section_desc: Upload light and dark logos. Leave empty to use the default SMARTCARE assets. Stored as site title images in tenant settings.
hospitals.logo_optional_hint: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG · max 10MB
hospitals.host_preview_placeholder: Enter a slug to preview the host.
hospitals.submitting_hint: Schema clone, package seeding, and identity bootstrap run sequentially. Please wait.
hospitals.empty_description: Click "Add Company" in the top right to register the first one.
hospitals.load_error: Failed to load companies. Please retry.
hospitals.auth_required: Authentication required. Sign in again and reopen the companies page.
hospitals.permission_denied: Missing moabom-system.saas.read permission. Ask an admin to sync module permissions.
hospitals.confirm_purge_db: Delete runtime DB data (members, posts, etc.) and restore baseline for slug "{slug}". Continue?
hospitals.confirm_purge_storage: Delete uploaded Storage (appearance seed blobs kept) for slug "{slug}". Continue?
hospitals.confirm_destroy: Fully delete registry, DB, and GCS for slug "{slug}" / host "{host}". This cannot be undone. Continue?

settings.title: My Page Settings
settings.description: Manage My Page menus and the theme, background, and preference choices customers can select.
settings.save_error: Failed to save My Page settings.
settings.menus_description: Manage visibility and default order of My Page sidebar menus.
settings.appearance_description: Manage which themes, point-color presets, and uploaded home backgrounds customers see in My Page on the site. This does not style the admin UI.
settings.preferences_description: Manage which languages and effect options customers see in My Page.
settings.home_background_upload_description: Registered images appear in My Page. Drag to set display order.
settings.languages_description: Only checked languages appear in the My Page language selector. The default language comes from the customer's choice or browser language detection.
settings.system_options_description: Defaults apply only to customers who have not saved their own settings yet. Disable user editing to prevent changing an option in My Page.
settings.font_size_default_description: The starting font-size level applied to customers (including guests) who have not changed it themselves.
settings.font_size_default_hint: Level 1 is the smallest and level 5 is the largest. The default is level 2.
